description: File import fixtures (Paket 11, Phase B; contract: docs/analyse/Paket11-PhaseB-Datei-IO-Vertrag.md, findings F1..F14: docs/analyse/Paket11-PhaseA-Datei-IO-Analyse.md). Every case is a real file: 'bytes' are hex bytes (separated by spaces, empty = 0 bytes) or 'generate' is a byte count of the deterministic ASCII text of 'generator' (written at test run time, never versioned). 'file' is the file name. Import paths: 'button' = OpenFileButton (real file chosen with DOM.setFileInputFiles, the Chromium file chooser path) and 'drop' = drag-and-drop onto the Remove textarea (real file dropped with Input.dispatchDragEvent). Before every case the target textarea holds 'previousText'. Expectations describe the CURRENT behaviour: { text } = the textarea state is exactly this text and no error message is shown, { generatedText: true } = the state is exactly the generated text, { unchanged: true } = 'previousText' stays and no message is shown, { rejected: invalidEncoding | tooLarge | unsupportedExtension, message? } = 'previousText' stays and an error message is shown ('message' = its exact current text). 'expected' applies to both paths; a case where the paths differ uses 'expectedButton' + 'expectedDrop'. 'target' is the decided behaviour of the contract (both paths; a rejected target names no message text, the wording is open), always with 'pending' { decisions, phase, paths, reason }: exactly the paths listed in 'paths' still differ from the target (checked against the real app by the integration tests and for consistency by tests/unit/file-io-fixtures.test.ts). A case without 'target' already meets the contract. 'ref' is a Phase A finding, 'note' explains a case.

generator.note: The generated text is 'line' repeated and cut to the byte count (ASCII only, so bytes = UTF-16 code units).

pending.reason: OpenFileButton only sets a truthy content (if (content)); an empty file is silently ignored.
The BOM is removed, the content '' is ignored by the truthiness check.
As the UTF-8 BOM: decoded to '' and ignored by the button.
As the UTF-8 BOM: decoded to '' and ignored by the button.

cases.name: UTF-8 with BOM: the BOM is removed
cases.bytes: EF BB BF 47 72 C3 BC C3 9F 65

cases.name: UTF-8 with two BOMs: only the first one is the signature
cases.bytes: EF BB BF EF BB BF 61
cases.note: The second U+FEFF is content (ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE) and is kept.

pending.reason: readAsText replaces invalid bytes with U+FFFD without a message.

cases.name: truncated UTF-8 sequence at the end

pending.reason: The incomplete 4-byte sequence becomes one U+FFFD.
No encoding detection (D6): the bytes are invalid UTF-8 and must be refused instead of damaged.
UTF-8 must not encode surrogates; every byte becomes U+FFFD.
Overlong '/' is invalid UTF-8.
Without a BOM the file is read as UTF-8 (D6: no detection); E4 00 is invalid UTF-8.

cases.name: UTF-16LE without BOM, ASCII only (valid UTF-8 with NUL)
cases.note: D6: no encoding detection. The bytes are valid UTF-8 (NUL is a valid character), so the contract keeps this result.

cases.name: UTF-16LE with BOM and a lone surrogate

pending.reason: An unpaired high surrogate is an invalid UTF-16 sequence and becomes U+FFFD.

cases.name: UTF-16LE with BOM and an odd byte count

divergence.reason: Chromium's FileReader.readAsText silently drops the incomplete last code unit (the WHATWG decode gives U+FFFD; Chromium's TextDecoder does so too and throws with fatal: true). Silent data loss, found in Phase B.

pending.reason: The last single byte is an incomplete code unit; today it is dropped without a message.

cases.name: U+2028 and U+2029 inside a line
exactly 10 MiB
cases.note: D7: the limit is inclusive. The drop limit is `file.size > maxSize`, so exactly 10 MiB is already allowed.

expectedDrop.message: File is too large. Maximum size is 10.0MB

pending.reason: OpenFileButton has no size limit.
The drop checks file.name.endsWith('.txt') case-sensitively.
The drop checks file.name.endsWith('.txt') case-sensitively.
accept=".txt" only preselects the dialog filter; a file chosen with another extension ("All files") is read.
OpenFileButton does not check the extension.

scenarioDescription: Import flows of the integration tests (checkFileIo in tests/e2e/lib/app.mjs, same names). 'current' and 'target' are the observations of the flow; 'pending' { decisions, phase, fields, reason } lists exactly the fields where 'current' still differs from 'target' (none = the flow already meets the contract). 'method': 'real' = real file chooser path / real drop and real reads, 'gated' = real reads whose START is held and released by the test in a fixed order (controlled race simulation, FileReader and Blob read methods wrapped in the page), 'intercepted' = the file chooser is opened with a user gesture and intercepted by CDP (no native dialog). 'readOnly' is the readOnly attribute of the target textarea, 'busy' its aria-busy="true" (the proposed test hook for the visible loading hint D11).

scenarios.name: same file chosen again
scenarios.steps: Choose A (FILE_A + CRLF) on Split, edit the text, choose A again, change A on disk and choose it again, choose B then A, leave the page and come back, choose A again.

pending.reason: The input keeps its value, Chromium fires no change event for the same path.

scenarios.name: read error on the button
scenarios.steps: A path that does not exist is chosen on Split (real change event, the FileReader fails with NotFoundError).

pending.reason: useSnackbar() is called inside reader.onerror: 'Invalid hook call' (production: Minified React error #321) instead of the message.

scenarios.name: read error on the drop
scenarios.steps: A path that does not exist is dropped onto the Remove textarea.

scenarios.name: loading state of the shared target
scenarios.steps: Choose a file on Split and hold its read; check the textarea, select text, type with real key input, check the file input; release.

pending.reason: No loading state: the textarea stays editable, typed text is replaced by the file later.

scenarios.name: newer file replaces a running import
scenarios.steps: Choose A, then B on Split (both reads held); release B, then A.

pending.reason: Every FileReader sets the text when it finishes; the older file A overwrites B.

scenarios.name: replaced import fails late
scenarios.steps: Choose A, then B on Split (both held); release B; delete A on disk; release A (real NotFoundError).

pending.reason: A late error of a replaced import must be ignored silently; today it throws the hook error (F1).

scenarios.name: button and drop share the Remove target
scenarios.steps: Choose A with the button, then drop B onto the Remove textarea (both held); release B, then A.

pending.reason: Button and drop read independently; nothing coordinates the shared target.

scenarios.name: independent Diff targets
scenarios.steps: Hold an import into the old Diff text, then one into the new Diff text; release both.

pending.reason: No loading state yet; only the target of an import may be locked.

scenarios.name: navigation during an import into the shared text
scenarios.steps: Hold an import on Split, go to Sort, check the Sort textarea, release.

pending.reason: The shared text is reachable on every page; the lock must follow the target, not the button.

scenarios.name: navigation during an import into the new Diff text
scenarios.steps: Hold an import into the new Diff text, go to Split, release; then go back to Diff.

scenarios.name: cancelled file dialog
scenarios.steps: Choose A on Split, edit the text, open the file chooser with a user gesture and close it without a file (no change; the cancel event Chromium fires is dispatched by the test), then choose A again.

pending.reason: After a cancel the input still holds A; choosing A again fires no change (F3).
